_README: EVERY user-facing string in the product lives in this file. If you are adding text a person will read, add a key here and reference it — do not write it into a component. This file is also the answer to 'where does that word come from?', which is otherwise hard: strings assembled by code are invisible to search. Ones that caused real trouble here were a module-level STEPS constant, a ternary ('Payment' : 'Confirm'), a pluralising conditional, helper functions returning English prose (getRateLabel, getDepositCopy), and 'Personal Information' written in title case but rendered uppercase by CSS — so grepping the visible text found nothing. Locale files other than en.json may be partial; missing keys fall back to English per key, which is why English must stay complete.
